meta.title: Jadoo — Travel, enjoy and live a new and full life

hero.titlePost: and live a new and full life.
hero.desc: Plan and book your perfect trip with expert advice, travel tips, destination information and inspiration from us.

rome.name: Rome
rome.blurb: Nine days between Trastevere, Testaccio and a family farm in the Lazio hills.

istanbul.name: Istanbul
istanbul.blurb: Ferries before breakfast, the spice market after lunch, and both shores of the Bosphorus.

lisbon.name: Lisbon
lisbon.blurb: Tram 28 at first light, tiled courtyards in Alfama, and a slow day out to Sintra.

kyoto.name: Kyoto
kyoto.blurb: Temple mornings, quiet ryokan nights, and a day on foot along the old post road.

destinations.title: Four cities, known street by street
destinations.intro: Each trip is small, slow and written for the season you travel in.

services.title: What we take care of
services.intro: You bring the curiosity. We handle the parts that usually eat a holiday.

flights.title: Flights that make sense
flights.desc: Direct where we can, sensible connections where we can’t, and seats chosen before you ask.

rooms.title: Rooms with a reason
rooms.desc: Small hotels and guesthouses we have slept in ourselves, close to what you came to see.

hosts.title: Local hosts
hosts.desc: A historian in Rome, a ferry captain’s son in Istanbul: people who show you their city, not a script.

flex.title: A plan that bends
flex.desc: Free days are built in. Change your mind on day three and we change the plan with you.

choose.title: Tell us roughly where and when
choose.desc: Pick a city and a month. Rough dates are fine; we ask the rest in one short call.

draft.title: Read a day-by-day draft
draft.desc: Within two working days you receive a written itinerary with rooms, guides and prices.

deposit.title: Pay a deposit, then pack
deposit.desc: A deposit holds your place. The balance is due thirty days before you fly.

doc.title: Rome, nine days
doc.d1: Arrive at Fiumicino. Dinner in Trastevere at eight.
doc.d2: Testaccio market with Giulia, lunch at her family’s stall.
doc.d3: Free morning. Afternoon at the Borghese, tickets held.
doc.d4: Train to the Lazio hills. Olive harvest and supper at the farm.

mike.quote: We had been to Rome twice and never seen it like this. Giulia’s market morning is the thing we still talk about.

chris.quote: The draft arrived in two days and they changed it three times without a sigh. Kyoto in November, perfectly paced.

subscription.title: A letter from the road, once a month.
subscription.text: New departures, a city we are scouting, and one good place to eat. No offers, no countdowns.
subscription.thanks: You’re on the list. The next letter goes out at the start of the month.

footer.tagline: Small-group trips to four cities, planned by people who know them.
footer.credits: Photographs on Unsplash by Braden Collum, Süheyl Burak, Freguesia de Estrela, Daisy Chen, Marialaura Gionfriddo, Ahmet Kahveci and Matthew Foulds.
